message: Hi, I'm a student with a python certification background. My overall academic average is 77.7% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in IOT and cloud computing. I want to become a Portal Administrator. My family can afford at most about USD 2400 per year. I live in Pune. I'd strongly prefer to stay near home, though I might consider elsewhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in IOT and cloud computing

explanation:
This program is located in Pune, matching your strong preference to stay near home. It focuses on networking and cloud, aligning with your interests (IOT/cloud), and has a high placement rate and median salary among the local options.

This is another Pune-based option focusing on networking and cloud computing. It has a very low tuition fee ($1250), keeping you well within your budget, while still offering relevant technical skills for a Portal Administrator role.

While not purely technical, this MBA in Delhi offers high placement potential and is related to IT management. Since getting a good job is your top priority, the strong salary and placement rate make it a valuable consideration.

Located in Delhi, this MSc IT Operations program directly relates to system administration roles (like Portal Administrator) and covers networking/cloud. The tuition is within budget, making it a strong contender if you are willing to consider Delhi.

This PG Diploma in Hyderabad is highly relevant as 'Systems Administration' directly matches your career goal of becoming a Portal Administrator. It also has the lowest tuition fee among all options and is located in a city you might consider.
